declared_noncontiguous_definition_excerp.source_excerpt:
In a unimodular chart its
coordinates $z_i$ satisfy
\[
 r=\text{unit}\cdot\prod_{i=1}^4 z_i^{\ell_i},
 \qquad q=\text{unit}\cdot\prod_{i=1}^4 z_i^{k_i}.
 \tag{A.24d}
\]

The first two have orders $3,4$; the last is unipotent. We put
$\epsilon=(1,2,-4,0)^t$, $\epsilon'=(1,3,-3,0)^t$,
$v_1=\epsilon$, $v_2=-\epsilon'$, $l_0=0$, and
$p=12l_0-4l_1-3l_2=-1$.

The untwisted family is
$X(u)=M_S^{\times,\circ}/\langle u\phi\rangle$, completed at infinity
by its Mumford fibre; the sphere family is $X_w$.

Let $\pi:\mathcal X\to\Delta$ be a proper holomorphic submersion
whose fibres are diffeomorphic to $S^6$.  Suppose that for every
$t\ne0$ the fibre is one of the members of E.2.1, with the same
coprime multiplicities $(3k,4l)$.  Set
\[
 A=12kl,\qquad D=kl-3k-4l\ne0.
\]

Normalize the punctured family to fixed
discrete logarithmic data with multiplicities $(3k,4l)$, and
write its isomorphism parameter as
\[
 z=\exp\!\left(-\frac{\pi i c}{kl}\right).
\]
